name: deepseekv41_mxfp8_linear_n5120_k15360
description: sglang's MXFP8 linear of a DeepSeek-V4.1 layer on gfx950 (aiter_mxfp8_blockscaled_linear), before any bias: x @ weight.T, weight fp8 e4m3 at an e8m0 scale per 32 x 32 block.
